description: Discover top institutional holders across the entire company universe ranked by assets under management (AUM). Unlike get_ownership which shows institutions for a single company, this tool searches across all companies to find the largest institutional players. Optionally set a minimum AUM. Useful for identifying smart money flows and major institutional positioning trends.

minAum.description: Minimum AUM in USD to filter institutions (e.g., 1000000000 for $1B+)

name: get_institution_top_aum
title: Get Top Institutions by AUM
